jobs.title: Product Manager - Data Platform
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA; Charlotte, North Carolina, USA; Chicago, Illinois, USA; Portland, Oregon, USA
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

As a Product Manager for Dirac, you will own the product strategy for the platform that holds and serves our customers' data. You'll set the direction for how data is stored, processed at rest, queried, and federated across clouds, regions, and sovereign boundaries, and for how AI changes all of those.

This role spans four big areas:

- Storage : Deciding how we store, tier, retain, and price data at enormous scale, and making sure the economics work for both customers and New Relic.

- Query : Making Dirac the place customers go to ask questions, using NRQL, SQL, or natural language through AI. You'll own the experience for engineers, analysts, and agents alike.

- At-rest processing : Moving work to the data instead of the other way around. This covers streaming alerts, continuous aggregation, and roll-ups that make large datasets fast and cheap to use.

- Federation : Querying data where it lives, whether that's in New Relic, in the customer's own storage, or across regions. This covers New Relic Lens, data sovereignty and residency, and a single view across data the customer owns.

The team is customer-led, highly technical, and moves fast. You'll thrive here if you're curious and excitable about hard problems, comfortable with complexity and ambiguity, and like to experiment, including with AI, to find the answer instead of waiting for it. If you want to spend time with customers, go deep with engineers, and shape a platform used by thousands of companies, this is the role for you!

What you'll do

- Own the vision and strategy for Dirac : Turn a long-term view of storage, at-rest processing, query, and federation into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and update it as the market and the technology change.

- Act as a true full business owner : Take initiative to spot roadblocks, line up resources, and drive complex platform initiatives to completion. Know your query volume, data growth, unit costs, and margins.

- Define the future of querying observability data : Shape how customers use NRQL, SQL, and AI-driven natural language queries, and how AI agents become first-class users of the platform.

- Drive at-rest processing : Define the product for streaming alerts, aggregation, and in-platform processing, so customers get answers faster and spend less to get them.

- Lead federation and data sovereignty : Build the strategy for querying data across clouds, regions, and customer-owned storage, including Lens, data residency, and compliance requirements.

- Experiment with AI, both in the product and in your own work : Prototype, test, and ship AI features on top of the platform. Use AI tools every day to move faster, analyze data, and level up your craft.

- Talk with customers constantly : From the largest enterprises to fast-growing startups, learn how they store and query data, where they get stuck, and what they wish they could do.

- Be data-driven : Define and track platform metrics such as query volume, latency, data stored, cost per GB, and adoption, and use them to make decisions and tell the story.

- Partner across the company : Work closely with engineering, architecture, design, finance, sales, and marketing to deliver end-to-end value and successful go-to-market launches.

- Bring clarity to complexity : Explain deep technical tradeoffs to engineers in 20 minutes and to executives in 20 seconds, and get people aligned when the path isn't obvious.

This role requires

- A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. A background in Computer Science or a related technical field is preferred.

- 5+ years of product management experience building and launching technical products, ideally platform, data, or infrastructure products.

- A strong technical foundation. You can go deep on storage, query engines, distributed systems, and cloud architecture with your engineering partners.

- Hands-on experience with AI and LLM tools, both to make yourself more productive and to build products on top of them.

- A proven ability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data and turn it into high-impact decisions.

- Comfort with ambiguity and complexity. You can take a vague problem and turn it into an actionable plan.

- Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

- A strong bias for action. You don't wait for direction; you figure out what needs to happen and lead the charge.

Bonus points if you have

- Experience with databases, data warehouses, lakehouses, or query engines (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Druid, Elasticsearch).

- Experience with observability

- Experience with streaming and real-time processing systems (e.g. Kafka, Flink).

- Familiarity with data sovereignty, data residency, or regulated environments (e.g. FedRAMP, HIPAA, GDPR).

- Direct experience with observability products or telemetry data at scale.

- Experience with usage-based pricing, unit economics, or COGS on a data platform.

- Experience with public cloud infrastructure services (AWS / Azure / GCP).

- Enterprise B2B SaaS experience with a developer or data persona.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (Logs)
jobs.location: New York City, New York, USA
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

New Relic is looking for a technically fluent Senior Product Marketing Manager to own product marketing for Logs, one of the most strategic parts of our observability. In this role you will define how the market understands New Relic Logs, from positioning and messaging through launches, enablement, and competitive differentiation and you will be the person marketing, Product, and the field turn to when the conversation turns to log management, log analytics, and telemetry cost.

This is a role for a product marketer who is equally comfortable going deep with engineers on ingest pipelines, parsing rules, OpenTelemetry, and query performance as standing in front of a customer or a sales kickoff audience explaining why it matters. Logs are where observability meets cost, scale, and AI, and the buyer is increasingly forced to choose between keeping all their data and keeping their budget. If you want to own that narrative in a fast-moving category and see your messaging show up directly in pipeline and adoption, we want to hear from you.

What you'll do

- Responsible for Logs positioning and messaging: define and maintain the core positioning, messaging, and narrative for New Relic Logs across buyer personas and ensure it is applied consistently across web, campaigns, sales conversations, and analyst interactions.

- Lead Logs launches: Own end-to-end Logs launches, including tiering, messaging, content, enablement, and launch metrics, partnering with Product Management, Demand Generation, Corporate Communications, and Enablement.

- Build sales enablement that gets used: Create the pitch decks, narratives, discovery questions, objection handling, first-call decks, and talk tracks that help sellers and solution consultants run credible logs conversations, and drive adoption of that content across the field.

- Help with competitive differentiation: Partner with Competitive Intelligence to develop technically accurate Logs differentiation against leading solutions and translate it into battlecards, and displacement plays.

- Drive pricing, packaging, and cost narrative: Serve as the product marketing voice on Logs pricing and packaging, including data ingest and retention economics, tiering and data management strategies, and the cost-control story that is central to how logs are bought today.

- Create content: produce the solution briefs, blogs, webinars, demos, customer stories, and reference architectures that make the Logs value proposition concrete and defensible, grounded in real customer outcomes and measurable results.

- Know the buyer and the market: Own the voice of the customer for Logs through customer and prospect conversations, win/loss input, market research, and usage data, and feed those insights back into roadmap, messaging, and segment priorities.

- Represent New Relic Logs externally and internally at customer briefings, executive and field readouts, analyst inquiries, and industry events

- Define and report the metrics that show Logs product marketing is working, including pipeline contribution, attach and adoption rates, ingest growth, and enablement utilization.

This role requires

- 4–6 years of product marketing or closely related go-to-market experience in the observability space, with a strong preference for log management, monitoring, or AIOps

- Technical foundation: Bachelor’s degree in a technical or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on technical experience, with sufficient depth in log analytics, retention and tiering and to engage directly with product and engineering teams.

- Demonstrated ownership of product launches end-to-end, from positioning and messaging through enablement and post-launch measurement, with clear results you can speak to.

- A portfolio of messaging and content you personally wrote positioning frameworks, solution briefs, pitch decks, battlecards, or technical blogs, that was adopted and used by the field.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical capability into clear, compelling narratives for both practitioners and executives.

- Demonstrated ability to partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, Enablement, Competitive Intelligence, and Analyst Relations, and to operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

- Comfort with data: able to use product usage, pipeline, and market data to prioritize work and demonstrate impact.

Bonus points if you have

- Experience using AI tools or agentic workflows to accelerate research, content production, or enablement is a plus.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
